_comment: Editorial guardrails for Decade Trivia. These pages are printed and sold on Amazon KDP, where the two real account risks are (a) reproducing copyrighted text such as song lyrics, poems, film dialogue or advertising slogans, and (b) upsetting or unsuitable content in a book sold as gentle reminiscence therapy. Terms are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries; cues are raw regex fragments.
promptRules: Never reproduce song lyrics, poems, film or TV dialogue, advertising slogans or jingles, or any other copyrighted wording — not even a few words. Describe them instead.
Brand and product names may be mentioned factually ("which company made ..."), but never build a question out of a trademarked slogan, jingle or logo wording.
Nothing sad, frightening, medical, violent, sexual, political or religious. No deaths, disasters, crimes, scandals, illness, alcohol, tobacco or drugs.
No trivia about living people's private lives. Public achievements of the era are fine.
Keep every question warm, gentle and answerable by someone recalling their own youth.
